assertions.description: The method declares three required arguments: label, context, outputLength.
Calling the method with valid arguments returns a Promise (NewObject), not a synchronous value.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const p=t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8),new Uint8Array(8),32);const ok=p instanceof Promise;p.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return ok;})()

assertions.description: A label longer than 255 bytes rejects with RangeError, before the session state is consulted.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});try{await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(256),new Uint8Array(8),32);return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof RangeError;}finally{try{t.close();}catch(e){}}})()

assertions.description: A context longer than 255 bytes rejects with RangeError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});try{await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8),new Uint8Array(256),32);return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof RangeError;}finally{try{t.close();}catch(e){}}})()

assertions.description: An outputLength of 0 rejects with RangeError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});try{await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8),new Uint8Array(8),0);return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof RangeError;}finally{try{t.close();}catch(e){}}})()

assertions.description: An outputLength of 4096 passes argument validation — the implementation ceiling must be at least 4096 (the call then pends or rejects with InvalidStateError, never RangeError).
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const p=t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8),new Uint8Array(8),4096);const outcome=await Promise.race([p.then(()=>'resolved',(e)=>e&&e.name==='RangeError'?'range':'other'),new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(()=>r('pending'),1500))]);p.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return outcome!=='range';})()

assertions.description: A valid call pending on a session that fails to establish rejects with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const p=t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8),new Uint8Array(8),32);try{t.close();}catch(e){}try{await p;return false;}catch(e){return e&&e.name==='InvalidStateError';}})()
